API Reference › Image Library

labkit.image.previewBudget

Downsample image data to fit a display pixel budget.

Syntax

function [preview, info] = previewBudget(imageData, varargin)

Usage

[preview, info] = labkit.image.previewBudget(imageData, "MaxPixels", n)

Inputs

imageData
2-D or 3-D image matrix. Class and channel count are preserved.
MaxPixels
positive scalar display-pixel budget, default 1.2e6.
Expansion
positive scalar estimated processing-area multiplier before preview rendering, default 1. Use this when a workflow pads or expands the image before display.

Outputs

preview
imageData sampled at an integer stride when needed.
info
struct with scaleFactor, coordinateScale, maxPixels, estimatedPixels, sourceSize, and previewSize.

Example

[preview, info] = labkit.image.previewBudget(rgb, ...
"MaxPixels", 1.2e6, "Expansion", 25);
